scope: Exact zero-service lattice optimization at arbitrary command budgets, cap-count menu compression for common rewards, an implemented heterogeneous centered merged-origin resource scheme, detailed price-tree diagnostics, and end-to-end certified fixing.
disclosure: The R54 report, previous source and recorded results were inspected before deriving these additions. No R55 numerical experiments have run at this commit. Development regressions precede the fixed comparison study; failed tests, exceptions and amendments will be retained. This is deterministic computational validation, not statistical preregistration.

checks: heterogeneous kernels versus independent marginal calculations
merged-origin intervals versus complete book enumeration
exact lattice value versus complete book enumeration
arbitrary support holes in concave convolution
external instance binding and corrupted-certificate rejection
price diagnostic wrapper versus unchanged search without resource limits

methods: R52 per-anchor uniform grid when rewards are common
R49 class-box subdivision when rewards are common

positive_gap.construction: three SUBSET SUM-derived catalogs, disclosed as adversarial rather than operational data
positive_gap.rule: Every compared method has the same positive target within a row. Exact lattice or integer subset-sum references are computed separately.

lattice_scaling.rule: Retain varying heterogeneous rewards and prefix ceilings. Record exact resource length, states, time and independently checked zero-width proof.

screening.comparison: Unscreened solve versus screening plus reduced solve with the SAME total algorithm allowance. Record screening time, downstream time, complete verification, nodes, states, bytes and removed anchors/ineligible/ordinary commands. Keep the original-instance forced-command exclusion witnesses. No optimality is inferred merely from an unchanged incumbent.

limits.rule: Fresh subprocess for each method, identical elapsed algorithm alarms and address-space caps within a row. Setup and verification are separate. Numeric solver envelope calls receive at most half the row allowance each. Retain external termination and native-solver delay diagnostics.

diagnostics: evaluated nodes and generated nodes separately
serialized and compressed certificate bytes including original input
reporting: Report every prescribed run or explicit resource-limit/failure record. Zero rational width, positive certified tolerance, and numerical MIP brackets are distinct outcomes. Do not overwrite any earlier revision result. Synthetic engineering parameters are not represented as calibrated data. Mathematical complexity, implementation counts and wall time are separately stated.
